notes.title: Last day of Lazy Angel Mika Sale!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41349942/03b1d607a73df379f80ab0b607ad5d6b5822c376.png[/img]
Last day of Lazy Angel Mika 20% discount!
Find out how Mika is doing in the human land!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3340330/Lazy_Angel_Mika/

[b]To stay up to date with our releases, be sure to follow us on:[/b]
・[url=https://twitter.com/DieselmineL]X[/url]
・[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/diesel_int]Steam Publisher Homepage[/url]
・[url=https://discord.gg/xF7Km6tQBS]Discord[/url]
・[url=https://ci-en.dlsite.com/creator/25298]Ci-en[/url]

[b]☆About This Game[/b]
"Hospitality"... That is one of the most important study subject for angels, who will be guiding humans and providing them assistance in the future.
How-e-ver! This lazy, sluggish angel apprentice Mika over here has been skipping those lessons, so much she's in the verge of getting retained from promotion!
At this rate, she's going to be an angel apprentice for life...!?
To break the status quo, Goddess Freya gave orders to Mika and her angel apprentice friends, Bel and Az, to descend down to human land. Collect "Love" to avoid retention.
In a desert town full of mysteries, our Angel Apprentice Mika shall demonstrate her outstanding performance!
...or, maybe not...!


[b]☆Character Introduction[/b]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41349942/8cf43147a10e9ce3ffa775c81259f7b50219a433.png[/img]

[b]★Michael (Mika)[/b]
A downer, lazy angel apprentice who is also the protagonist of this game.
She skipped too many "Hospitality" lessons - a lesson for angels to help humans - and ended up having to descend to human land for make-up lessons...

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41349942/74e45d944d7e9c6a17de986be412ad9cdb669c47.png[/img]

[b]★Belzebuth (Bel)[/b]
A not-so-sharp, energetic angel apprentice.
She just can't get along with Mika, and they fight literally every time they encounter each other.
She's too dull to get any credit on Hospitality, and is forced to take make-up lessons with Mika.
However, bad thugs know a way or two around her ignorance...

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41349942/d8b76913b81cd8dca93f7517c81680dfc5592d32.png[/img]

[b]★Azrael (Az)[/b]
A somewhat cold, excellent role model-like angel, who is Mika and Bel's junior.
She is almost flawless, with the only flaw being her arrogance.
Goddess Freya gave her a mission to look after her underachieved seniors, and communicate with humans to soften her attitude while she's at it.
But of course, Az is so full of pride, and that doesn't exactly make things easy...

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41349942/38cbcfac54e6266c72bf9f496ae12714507dac76.png[/img]

[b]★Freya[/b]
A kind-hearted goddess who looks after Mika and others.
She always wears a gentle smile like a goddess.
She occasionally descends down to land to check up on Mika and the rest.


[b]☆Game System[/b]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41349942/38fe7c6aa2d3f6371d922cd114b41a6fb15c0d66.gif[/img]

Humans don't just open up their minds that easily.

Use the power of the angels to initiate multiple-choice quiz mini-game.
Within a time limit, pick the right answer out among the four choices to earn their trusts and gain some "Love"!
Quizzes range from general knowledge to in-game context!
When you find it difficult, there are also assist items that can help you find the correct answer!

Help Mika avoid retention by clearing quizzes and solve people's problems!


[b]☆A Variety of Dress Up Costumes![/b]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41349942/697d9b21b54732e25d4d4308bd9a1ddb46bf67b0.gif[/img]

There is a large variety of costumes and accessories!
Hair color, hairstyle, even skin color!
Ranging from simple cute and adorable to all kinds of fetishes!
Combine your favorite accessories for your own original Mika!

Costumes also affects Mika's appearance in sidescrolling view indoors!

notes.title: Milf Selena and the Dungeon of Magic Stones is coming soon!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/41349942/0598809f23be20950d8a021886e31075f54b9431.jpg[/img]
Selena, an ex-adventurer and a hero's wife, returned to the dungeon once again in search of material to repair an orb that seals a powerful monster from the past. However, she gets taken advantage of by a Dark Guild, becoming an adventurer by day, and their sex slave by night......

[b]CHARACTER[/b]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/41349942/8848a9adf0f1ae7abb7331bdebe471f75285946c.png[/img]
[b]Selena[/b]
Protagonist and a Hero's wife.
A mage who once fought alongside the Hero.
She's been bothered by her new lifestyle......

[b]H SYSTEM[/b][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/41349942/9b1ecfb72643ed9cba587f766460aca6a513155e.png[/img]
・Selena can wear various lewd costumes/accessories.
　Dress her up the way you like!
・H Scenes have Fertilize gauge = Womb durability system.
　When gauge reaches zero, she will realize she's pregnant on that night!
・Character images and H scenes have pregnant variation!
・Lewd Status system including pregnancy records and more!
・Contraception is also available for those who prefers to avoid such  
　content!

[b]BATTLE SYSTEM[/b][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/41349942/22f30342479c9e71f5f097ca017145281df5c899.jpg[/img]
Venture through the dungeon with your mercenaries!
・Mercenaries can be hired from various places.
　Each have their own unique skills, for countless variation of combinations.
・They get stronger the more they have sex, so make sure to raise your 
　favorite mercenaries well!
・Dungeon exploration in 3D view.
　Make full use of your vision and mapping system to traverse the dungeon!
